events.comment:

All drawing is done by code (see the "Engine" external events). Objects used are global: Paint, TxtBody, TxtBold, TxtTitle, Curio, NancyMap, Glass, Macaron, CardBack, Crest, NameInput.

inlineCode: // TITLE SCENE — welcome screen, resume, how to play
CN.screens.title = CN.screens.title || function (rs, UI) {
const C = CN.content, COL = CN.COL, W = UI.W, H = UI.H;
const T = CN.titleUI || (CN.titleUI = { how: false });
if (T.sid !== UI.sceneId) { T.sid = UI.sceneId; T.how = false; T.save = CN.loadSave(); }
// faded map of Nancy behind everything
const mk = Math.max(W / C.map.width, H / C.map.height) * 1.05;
UI.sprite("NancyMap", "bgmap", null, (W - C.map.width * mk) / 2, (H - C.map.height * mk) / 2, C.map.width * mk, C.map.height * mk, { alpha: .1, z: 1 });
const short = H < 560;
const col = Math.min(W - UI.pad * 2, 560);
let y = short ? UI.pad : Math.max(UI.pad, H * .08);
const crest = short ? 44 : 64;
UI.sprite("Crest", "crest", null, W / 2 - crest / 2, y, crest, crest); y += crest + 10;
const ts = CN.clamp(W * .085, 32, 64);
y += UI.text("t:t", "Curios of Nancy", W / 2, y, { anchor: "center", font: "title", size: ts, color: COL.gold }).h + 2;
y += UI.text("t:s", "The Great Heritage Quest", W / 2, y, { anchor: "center", font: "title", size: ts * .42, color: COL.gold2 }).h + 8;

y += UI.text("t:d", "A team-building game about Nancy’s culinary, artistic and cultural heritage", W / 2, y, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: short ? 13 : 16, color: COL.muted, wrap: col }).h + (short ? 8 : 18);
// parade of Curios
const parade = ["macarette", "gallebrille", "stanislion", "mirabulle", "daumino", "chardonnet", "jazzibou"];
const n = W < 420 ? 5 : 7, cs = CN.clamp(Math.min(W / (n + 1), H * .12), 44, 96);
parade.slice(0, n).forEach((id, i) => UI.curio("t:p" + i, id, W / 2 + (i - (n - 1) / 2) * cs * 1.05, y + cs / 2, cs, { phase: i }));
y += cs + (short ? 10 : 22);
// buttons
const bw = Math.min(col, 380), bh = short ? 46 : 54, bx = W / 2 - bw / 2;
const canResume = T.save && !T.save.over;
if (UI.button("t:new", bx, y, bw, bh, "New expedition", { size: 19 })) CN.go("Setup");
if (canResume) {
const s = T.save;

if (UI.button("t:res", bx, y, bw, bh, "Resume expedition", { kind: "ghost", sub: `${s.teams.length} teams · round ${Math.min(s.round + 1, s.rounds)} of ${s.rounds}` })) { CN.state = s; CN.levelUps = []; CN.go(s.current ? "Challenge" : "Hub"); }
if (UI.button("t:how", bx, y, bw, bh * .85, "How to play", { kind: "soft" })) T.how = true;
// sound toggle + credits
if (UI.button("t:snd", W - UI.pad - 96, UI.pad, 96, 36, CN.settings.sound ? "Sound on" : "Sound off", { kind: "soft", size: 13 })) { CN.settings.sound = !CN.settings.sound; CN.saveSettings(); }
UI.text("t:c", C.map.credit + " · Made with GDevelop", W / 2, H - 10, { anchor: "center", valign: "bottom", size: 11, color: COL.muted, wrap: W - 20, align: "center" });
if (T.how) {
const f = CN.modalFrame(560, Math.min(H - 30, 640));
let yy = f.y + 20;
UI.text("h:t", "How to play", f.x + 24, yy, { size: 24, font: "title", color: COL.gold2, top: true }); yy += 40;
C.howTo.forEach((line, i) => {
UI.circle(f.x + 34, yy + 10, 11, { fill: COL.gold, layer: "top" });
UI.text("h:n" + i, String(i + 1), f.x + 34, yy + 10, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", size: 12, bold: true, color: COL.night, top: true });
yy += UI.text("h:l" + i, line, f.x + 54, yy, { size: tsz, top: true, wrap: f.w - 80 }).h + 10;
if (UI.button("h:ok", f.x + 24, f.y + f.h - 62, f.w - 48, 46, "Got it!", { top: true })) T.how = false;

events.comment:
Setup — Choose 2–6 teams, their names and mascots, and the game length.
All drawing is done by code (see the "Engine" external events). Objects used are global: Paint, TxtBody, TxtBold, TxtTitle, Curio, NancyMap, Glass, Macaron, CardBack, Crest, NameInput.

inlineCode: // SETUP SCENE — number of teams, team names & mascots, game length
CN.screens.setup = CN.screens.setup || function (rs, UI) {
const C = CN.content, COL = CN.COL, W = UI.W, H = UI.H, P = UI.pad;
const S = CN.setupUI || (CN.setupUI = { n: 3, length: "standard", teams: C.teamPresets.map(t => Object.assign({}, t)) });
if (S.sid !== UI.sceneId) { S.sid = UI.sceneId; }
const mascots = C.curios.filter(c => c.id !== "mira").map(c => c.id);
// header
if (UI.button("su:back", P, P, 84, 38, "‹ Back", { kind: "soft", size: 14 })) CN.go("Title");
UI.text("su:t", "New expedition", W / 2, P + 19, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", font: "title", size: CN.clamp(W * .05, 22, 34), color: COL.gold2 });
const top = P + 38 + 14;
const land = !UI.portrait && W >= 700;
const sideW = land ? CN.clamp(W * .3, 250, 340) : W - P * 2;
const listX = P, listW = land ? W - P * 3 - sideW : W - P * 2;
const sideX = land ? W - P - sideW : P;
// ----- options block (team count, length, start) -----
function options(x, y, w) {
UI.text("su:nl", "TEAMS", x, y, { size: 12, bold: true, color: COL.muted }); y += 20;
const bs = 44;
if (UI.button("su:minus", x, y, bs, bs, "−", { kind: "soft", size: 22, disabled: S.n <= 2 })) S.n--;
UI.text("su:nv", S.n + " teams", x + bs + (w - bs * 2) / 2, y + bs / 2, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", size: 20, bold: true });
if (UI.button("su:plus", x + w - bs, y, bs, bs, "+", { kind: "soft", size: 22, disabled: S.n >= 6 })) S.n++;
UI.text("su:ll", "GAME LENGTH", x, y, { size: 12, bold: true, color: COL.muted }); y += 20;
const lw = (w - 16) / 3, lh = 52;

C.lengths.forEach((l, i) => { if (UI.button("su:l" + l.id, x + i * (lw + 8), y, lw, lh, l.name, { kind: "soft", selected: S.length === l.id, sub: `${l.rounds} stations`, size: 14 })) S.length = l.id; });
const len = C.lengths.find(l => l.id === S.length);
UI.text("su:lm", `${len.minutes} · ${len.rounds} stations + Grand Finale`, x + w / 2, y, { anchor: "center", size: 12, color: COL.muted }); y += 26;
if (UI.button("su:go", x, y, w, 56, "Start the expedition!", { size: 19 })) {
const names = new Set();
const teams = S.teams.slice(0, S.n).map((t, i) => {
let name = (t.name || "").trim() || C.teamPresets[i].name;
while (names.has(name.toLowerCase())) name += " 2";
names.add(name.toLowerCase());
return { name, color: t.color, curio: t.curio };
CN.newGame(teams, S.length); CN.sfx("fanfare", 50); CN.go("Hub");
return y + 56;
// ----- team cards -----
const cols = land ? (listW > 640 ? 2 : 1) : (W > 560 ? 2 : 1);
const availH = land ? H - top - P - 26 : H - top - P - optH - 30 - 26;
const rows = Math.ceil(S.n / cols), gap = 8;
const ch = CN.clamp((availH - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows, 44, 70), cw = (listW - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
UI.text("su:tl", "TAP A MASCOT TO CHANGE IT · TAP A NAME TO EDIT IT", listX, top, { size: 11, bold: true, color: COL.muted, wrap: listW });
for (let i = 0; i < S.n; i++) {
const t = S.teams[i];
const x = listX + (i % cols) * (cw + gap), y = top + 22 + Math.floor(i / cols) * (ch + gap);
UI.rect(x, y, cw, ch, { fill: COL.night2, stroke: t.color, sw: 1.5, r: 14 });
const bs = ch - 12;
UI.circle(x + 6 + bs / 2, y + ch / 2, bs / 2, { fill: t.color });
UI.curio("su:c" + i, t.curio, x + 6 + bs / 2, y + ch / 2, bs * .95, { bob: false });
if (UI.click(x, y, bs + 12, ch)) { t.curio = mascots[(mascots.indexOf(t.curio) + 1) % mascots.length]; CN.sfx("flip", 50); }
t.name = UI.input("su:in" + i, x + bs + 18, y + (ch - Math.min(40, ch - 10)) / 2, cw - bs - 30, Math.min(40, ch - 10), t.name, { size: CN.clamp(ch * .3, 14, 18), max: 22 });
if (land) options(sideX, top, sideW);
else options(P, top + 22 + rows * (ch + gap) + 14, W - P * 2);
CN.frame(runtimeScene, "setup");

events.comment:
Hub — The expedition map: the active team picks a station; scoreboard, levels and the Golden Gates goal.
All drawing is done by code (see the "Engine" external events). Objects used are global: Paint, TxtBody, TxtBold, TxtTitle, Curio, NancyMap, Glass, Macaron, CardBack, Crest, NameInput.

inlineCode: // HUB SCENE — the expedition map: pick a station, follow the scores
CN.screens.hub = CN.screens.hub || function (rs, UI) {
const C = CN.content, COL = CN.COL, st = CN.state, W = UI.W, H = UI.H, P = UI.pad;
const Hs = CN.hubUI || (CN.hubUI = {});
if (Hs.sid !== UI.sceneId) { Hs.sid = UI.sceneId; Hs.sel = null; Hs.dbl = false; }
const active = st.turn, team = st.teams[active];
const finaleDue = st.round >= st.rounds;
const barH = 44;
UI.sprite("Crest", "crest", null, P, P + 2, 40, 40);
UI.text("h:r", finaleDue ? "Grand Finale" : `Station ${st.round + 1} of ${st.rounds}`, P + 50, P + 4, { size: 18, font: "title", color: COL.gold2 });
const coll = CN.collective(), gw = CN.clamp(W * .28, 110, 300);
UI.text("h:gl", "GOLDEN GATES", P + 50, P + 27, { size: 10, bold: true, color: COL.muted });
UI.bar(P + 50 + 92, P + 29, Math.min(gw, W - P * 2 - 200), 8, coll / st.goal, COL.gold);
CN.menuButton(W - P - 40, P + 2);
const land = !UI.portrait;
const sideW = land ? CN.clamp(W * .34, 280, 420) : W - P * 2;
const top = P + barH + 12;
const mapR = land ? { x: P, y: top, w: W - sideW - P * 3, h: H - top - P } : { x: P, y: top, w: W - P * 2, h: CN.clamp(H * .42, 200, H - top - 270) };
const side = land ? { x: W - P - sideW, y: top, w: sideW, h: H - top - P } : { x: P, y: mapR.y + mapR.h + 12, w: W - P * 2, h: H - (mapR.y + mapR.h + 12) - P };
// ---------- map with stations ----------
const k = Math.min(mapR.w / C.map.width, mapR.h / C.map.height);
const M = { w: C.map.width * k, h: C.map.height * k }; M.x = mapR.x + (mapR.w - M.w) / 2; M.y = mapR.y + (mapR.h - M.h) / 2;
UI.rect(M.x - 5, M.y - 5, M.w + 10, M.h + 10, { fill: COL.gold, r: 10 });
UI.sprite("NancyMap", "map", null, M.x, M.y, M.w, M.h);
const r = CN.clamp(M.w * .028, 13, 24);
C.stations.forEach((s, i) => {
const f = CN.geoToMap(C.places[s.place].p), x = M.x + f[0] * M.w, y = M.y + f[1] * M.h;
const done = st.stations[s.id], tc = C.trails[s.trail].color;
if (done) {
const owner = st.teams[done.team];
UI.circle(x, y, r * .8, { fill: owner.color, stroke: COL.night, sw: 2, layer: "mid", alpha: .9 });
UI.text("h:ck" + i, "✓", x, y, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", size: r, bold: true, color: COL.night, z: 12 });
} else {
const pulse = finaleDue ? 0 : CN.pulse(3 + i * .2);
UI.circle(x, y, r + 4 + pulse * 3, { fill: tc, alpha: .35, layer: "mid" });
UI.circle(x, y, r, { fill: COL.night, stroke: tc, sw: 3, layer: "mid" });
UI.curio("h:c" + i, s.curio, x, y - 2, r * 1.9, { bob: false, z: 8 });
if (!finaleDue && UI.click(x - r - 6, y - r - 6, (r + 6) * 2, (r + 6) * 2)) { Hs.sel = s.id; Hs.dbl = false; CN.sfx("click"); }
// other place names are not shown: the map has no labels on purpose
let y = side.y;
if (!finaleDue) {
const tall = land && H >= 500;
const bh = tall ? 96 : 76;
UI.panel(side.x, y, side.w, bh, { stroke: team.color, sw: 2 });
UI.text("h:yt", "YOUR MOVE", side.x + 16, y + 12, { size: 11, bold: true, color: COL.muted });
CN.teamPill("h:ap", active, side.x + 14, y + 30, 34, { size: 16 });
if (tall) UI.text("h:pk", "Pick a station on the map", side.x + 16, y + bh - 22, { size: 13, color: COL.gold2 });
else UI.text("h:pk", "Pick a station!", side.x + side.w - 14, y + 47, { anchor: "right", valign: "middle", size: 13, color: COL.gold2 });
} else {
UI.panel(side.x, y, side.w, 110, { stroke: COL.gold, sw: 2 });
UI.text("h:ft", "Every station of this expedition is done!", side.x + 16, y + 12, { size: 15, bold: true, wrap: side.w - 32 });
if (UI.button("h:fin", side.x + 16, y + 56, side.w - 32, 42, "Start the Grand Finale", { size: 16 })) CN.startFinale();
// trail legend
let lx = side.x;
for (const id in C.trails) { lx += UI.chip("h:tr" + id, C.trails[id].name, lx, y, C.trails[id].color) + 6; }
// scoreboard
const order = st.teams.map((t, i) => i).sort((a, b) => st.teams[b].xp - st.teams[a].xp);
const cols = (!land && (side.w > 520 || order.length > 3)) || (land && (side.y + side.h - y) / order.length < 46) ? 2 : 1, gap = 8, rows = Math.ceil(order.length / cols);
const rh = CN.clamp((side.y + side.h - y - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows, 40, 74), cw = (side.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
const big = rh >= 60;
order.forEach((ti, k2) => {
const t = st.teams[ti], x = side.x + (k2 % cols) * (cw + gap), yy = y + Math.floor(k2 / cols) * (rh + gap);
const li = CN.levelInfo(t.xp);

UI.rect(x, yy, cw, rh, { fill: ti === active && !finaleDue ? CN.mix(t.color, COL.night2, .8) : COL.night2, stroke: ti === active && !finaleDue ? t.color : COL.line, sw: ti === active ? 2 : 1, r: 12 });
const bs = Math.min(rh - 14, cols > 1 ? 34 : 56);
CN.teamBadge("h:b" + ti, ti, x + 7, yy + (rh - bs) / 2, bs);
const tx = x + bs + 16, tw = cw - bs - 24;
if (cols > 1) {
UI.fitText("h:n" + ti, t.name, tx, yy + 7, tw, { size: 13, bold: true });
UI.fitText("h:x" + ti, `${CN.nf(t.xp)} XP · Lv ${li.level}`, tx, yy + 25, tw - 30, { size: 12, color: COL.gold2 });
} else {
UI.fitText("h:n" + ti, t.name, tx, yy + (big ? 8 : 5), tw - 70, { size: big ? 15 : 13, bold: true });
UI.text("h:x" + ti, CN.nf(t.xp) + " XP", x + cw - 10, yy + (big ? 8 : 5), { anchor: "right", size: big ? 14 : 12, bold: true, color: COL.gold2 });
if (big) UI.text("h:lv" + ti, `Lv ${li.level} · ${li.title}`, tx, yy + 28, { size: 12, color: COL.muted });
const extras = t.curios.length || t.perks.help || t.perks.double;
UI.bar(tx, yy + rh - 13, tw - (extras ? 62 : 0), 6, li.frac, t.color);
const tokW = CN.perkTokens("h:pt" + ti, ti, x + cw - 60, yy + rh - 22);
if (t.curios.length) UI.text("h:cu" + ti, "♥" + t.curios.length, x + cw - 60 + tokW, yy + rh - 20, { size: 12, color: "#EF7FA6", bold: true });
if (Hs.sel) {
const s = CN.stationById(Hs.sel), pl = C.places[s.place], tr = C.trails[s.trail], cu = CN.curioById(s.curio);
const f = CN.modalFrame(480, Math.min(H - 20, 430 + (team.perks.double > 0 ? 50 : 0)), { color: tr.color });
const short = f.h < 440;
let yy = f.y + 18;
const cs = short ? 70 : 110;
UI.curio("sc:c", s.curio, f.x + f.w / 2, yy + cs / 2, cs, { top: true });
yy += cs + 6;
UI.text("sc:t", s.title, f.x + f.w / 2, yy, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: 24, font: "title", color: COL.gold2, top: true, wrap: f.w - 40 }); yy += 32;

const chipsW = UI.chip("sc:tr", tr.name + " trail", -999, -999, tr.color, { top: true }) + 8 + UI.chip("sc:wh", s.who === "all" ? "All teams play" : "Team challenge", -999, -999, COL.gold2, { top: true });
let cx = f.x + (f.w - chipsW) / 2;
cx += UI.chip("sc:tr", tr.name + " trail", cx, yy, tr.color, { top: true }) + 8;
UI.chip("sc:wh", s.who === "all" ? "All teams play" : "Team challenge", cx, yy, COL.gold2, { top: true });
yy += UI.text("sc:pl", `${cu.name} guards ${pl.name}`, f.x + f.w / 2, yy, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: 14, color: COL.muted, top: true, wrap: f.w - 40 }).h + 8;
yy += UI.text("sc:b", s.blurb, f.x + f.w / 2, yy, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: 15, top: true, wrap: f.w - 48 }).h + 10;
if (team.perks.double > 0) {

if (UI.button("sc:dbl", f.x + 24, yy, f.w - 48, 40, Hs.dbl ? "Double Down: ON (×2 points)" : `Use Double Down? (${team.perks.double} left)`, { top: true, kind: Hs.dbl ? "primary" : "ghost", color: COL.warm, size: 14 })) Hs.dbl = !Hs.dbl;
const by = f.y + f.h - 62, half = (f.w - 56) / 2;
if (UI.button("sc:back", f.x + 24, by, half, 46, "Back", { top: true, kind: "soft" })) Hs.sel = null;
if (UI.button("sc:go", f.x + 32 + half, by, half, 46, "Play!", { top: true, color: tr.color })) { const id = Hs.sel; Hs.sel = null; CN.startStation(id, Hs.dbl); }
CN.frame(runtimeScene, "hub", { needsGame: true });

events.comment:
Challenge — Briefing → mini-game → results with the heritage fact of the place.
All drawing is done by code (see the "Engine" external events). Objects used are global: Paint, TxtBody, TxtBold, TxtTitle, Curio, NancyMap, Glass, Macaron, CardBack, Crest, NameInput.

inlineCode: // CHALLENGE SCENE — briefing, the mini-game, then results & a heritage fact
CN.screens.challenge = CN.screens.challenge || function (rs, UI) {
const C = CN.content, COL = CN.COL, st = CN.state, W = UI.W, H = UI.H, P = UI.pad;
if (!st.current) { CN.go("Hub"); return; }
if (!CN.ctx || CN.ctx.sid !== UI.sceneId || CN.ctx.cur !== st.current) { CN.ctx = CN.makeCtx(); CN.ctx.sid = UI.sceneId; }
const ctx = CN.ctx, s = ctx.station, fin = !s;
const title = fin ? C.finale.title : s.title;
const color = fin ? COL.gold : C.trails[s.trail].color;
const guardian = fin ? "stanislion" : s.curio;
const allTeams = fin || s.who === "all";
const hh = UI.compact ? 50 : 58;
UI.rect(0, 0, W, hh + P * .6, { fill: COL.night2 });
UI.rect(0, hh + P * .6 - 3, W, 3, { fill: color });
const cs = hh - 8;
UI.curio("c:g", guardian, P + cs / 2, P * .3 + hh / 2, cs, { bob: false });
const titleW = W - P * 2 - cs - 60 - (UI.compact ? 0 : 230);
UI.fitText("c:t", title, P + cs + 10, P * .3 + 6, titleW, { size: UI.compact ? 18 : 22, font: "title", color: COL.gold2 });

UI.fitText("c:p", fin ? "Every team plays · 150 points per question" : C.places[s.place].name + (ctx.cur.double ? " · DOUBLE DOWN ×2" : ""), P + cs + 10, P * .3 + (UI.compact ? 28 : 34), titleW, { size: 12, color: ctx.cur.double ? COL.warm : COL.muted, bold: ctx.cur.double });
CN.menuButton(W - P - 40, P * .3 + (hh - 40) / 2);
let rx = W - P - 50;
if (!UI.compact) {
if (allTeams) { const w = 104; UI.chip("c:all", "All teams", rx - w, P * .3 + hh / 2 - 12, COL.gold2); rx -= w + 8; }
else { const tmp = CN.teamPill("c:tp", ctx.team, -999, -999, 32, { size: 14 }); rx -= tmp; CN.teamPill("c:tp", ctx.team, rx, P * .3 + (hh - 32) / 2, 32, { size: 14 }); rx -= 8; }
// Mira's Help (active team, once per challenge)
const t = st.teams[ctx.team];
if (ctx.started && !ctx.done && ctx.helpable && !ctx.cur.helpUsed && t.perks.help > 0 && ctx.canHelp && ctx.canHelp()) {
const bw = 124, bx = UI.compact ? W - P - 50 - bw : rx - bw;
if (UI.button("c:help", bx, P * .3 + (hh - 36) / 2, bw, 36, "Mira’s Help", { color: COL.gold, size: 13 })) { if (CN.useHelp()) { ctx.onHelp(); CN.toast("Mira’s Help used!", COL.gold); } }
const A = { x: P, y: hh + P * .6 + P, w: W - P * 2, h: H - (hh + P * .6 + P) - P };
if (!ctx.started) {
const f = { w: Math.min(A.w, 560) }; f.x = W / 2 - f.w / 2;
const short = A.h < 420;
let y = A.y + (short ? 0 : A.h * .04);
const big = short ? 80 : CN.clamp(A.h * .26, 100, 180);
UI.curio("c:bc", guardian, W / 2, y + big / 2, big); y += big + 8;
y += UI.text("c:bt", title, W / 2, y, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: short ? 24 : 32, font: "title", color: COL.gold2, wrap: f.w }).h + 8;
const who = fin ? "Every team plays: the fastest buzzer answers." : allTeams ? "Every team plays this one!" : `${t.name}, this one is for your team.`;
y += UI.text("c:bw", who, W / 2, y, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: 16, bold: true, color: allTeams ? COL.gold : t.color, wrap: f.w }).h + 8;

// Each challenge has init(ctx) and frame(ctx, area). "ctx" holds the
// running challenge; ctx.give(team, points) scores; ctx.finish() ends it.
//   quiz     — team answers 3 questions, others can steal a miss
//   buzzer   — all teams race to buzz first (also the Grand Finale)
//   map      — all teams pin landmarks on the map of Nancy
//   recipe   — pick the authentic ingredients of Lorraine dishes
//   toss     — timing game, every teammate throws a macaron
//   match    — memory pairs: artist ↔ craft
//   puzzle   — rebuild a stained-glass window
//   timeline — order key dates of Nancy's history
window.CN = window.CN || {};
if (!window.CN.challenges) (function () {
const CN = window.CN, C = CN.content, UI = CN.ui, COL = CN.COL;
const CH = CN.challenges = {};
CN.makeCtx = function () {
const st = CN.state, cur = st.current;
const station = cur.station === "finale" ? null : CN.stationById(cur.station);
const ctx = { cur, station, type: cur.type, team: st.turn, pts: st.teams.map(() => 0), pops: [], done: false, max: 0, helpable: false, tickAt: 0 };
ctx.give = (ti, pts, o = {}) => { const got = CN.award(ti, pts, o); ctx.pts[ti] += got; if (got > 0) ctx.pop("+" + got, o.x, o.y, st.teams[ti].color); CN.save(); return got; };
ctx.pop = (text, x, y, color) => ctx.pops.push({ text, x: x == null ? UI.W / 2 : x, y: y == null ? UI.H / 2 : y, color: color || COL.gold2, t: UI.t });
ctx.setTimer = s => { ctx.end = UI.t + s; ctx.dur = s; };
ctx.left = () => Math.max(0, ctx.end - UI.t);
ctx.finish = function () {
if (ctx.done) return; ctx.done = true; ctx.doneAt = UI.t;
const allTeams = ctx.type === "buzzer" || ctx.type === "map" || ctx.type === "finale";
let friend = null;
if (station) {
if (allTeams) { const best = Math.max(...ctx.pts); if (best > 0) friend = ctx.pts.indexOf(best); }
else if (ctx.pts[ctx.team] >= ctx.max * .5) friend = ctx.team;
if (friend != null) ctx.befriended = CN.befriend(friend, station.curio) ? friend : null;
ctx.friend = friend;
cur.results = { summary: ctx.pts.slice(), friend };
CN.save();
CN.sfx(ctx.pts.some(p => p > 0) ? "fanfare" : "wrong", 60);
if (ctx.pts.some(p => p > 0)) CN.burst(50);
ctx.start = () => { ctx.started = true; CH[ctx.type === "finale" ? "buzzer" : ctx.type].init(ctx); };
ctx.frame = A => CH[ctx.type === "finale" ? "buzzer" : ctx.type].frame(ctx, A);
return ctx;
const teamName = ti => CN.state.teams[ti].name;
const teamCol = ti => CN.state.teams[ti].color;
function drawTimer(ctx, x, y, w) {
const left = ctx.left(), frac = left / ctx.dur;
const col = frac > .5 ? COL.ok : frac > .2 ? COL.warm : COL.bad;
UI.bar(x, y, w, 8, frac, col);
if (left > 0 && left <= 5 && Math.ceil(left) !== ctx.tickAt) { ctx.tickAt = Math.ceil(left); CN.sfx("tick", 60); }
return left;
// Answer button with wrapping text. state: normal | right | wrong | dim | off
function answerBtn(key, x, y, w, h, label, state, top) {
let fill = COL.night3, stroke = COL.line, txt = COL.text, alpha = 1;
if (state === "right") { fill = CN.mix(COL.ok, COL.night, .45); stroke = COL.ok; }
if (state === "wrong") { fill = CN.mix(COL.bad, COL.night, .5); stroke = COL.bad; }
if (state === "dim" || state === "off") alpha = state === "off" ? .28 : .6;
const clickable = state === "normal";
if (clickable && UI.pressing(x, y, w, h, top)) fill = CN.mix(fill, COL.gold, .25);
else if (clickable && UI.over(x, y, w, h, top) && !UI.down) stroke = COL.gold;
UI.rect(x, y, w, h, { fill, stroke, sw: 1.5, r: 12, alpha, layer: top ? "top" : "bg" });
UI.text(key, label, x + w / 2, y + h / 2, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", align: "center", size: CN.clamp(h * .3, 13, 19), wrap: w - 24, alpha, top });
return clickable && UI.click(x, y, w, h, top);
function optionsLayout(A, n) {
const two = A.w >= 520;
const cols = two ? 2 : 1, rows = Math.ceil(n / cols), gap = 10;
const h = CN.clamp((A.h - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows, 44, 96);
const w = (A.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
return i => ({ x: A.x + (i % cols) * (w + gap), y: A.y + Math.floor(i / cols) * (h + gap), w, h });
function questionCard(key, text, x, y, w) {
const size = CN.clamp(w * .045, 17, 26);
const m = UI.text(key, text, x + w / 2, y + 16, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size, bold: true, wrap: w - 36 });
UI.rect(x, y, w, m.h + 32, { fill: COL.night2, stroke: COL.gold, sw: 1.2, r: 16 });
return m.h + 32;
function note(key, text, x, y, w, color) {
return UI.text(key, text, x + w / 2, y, { anchor: "center", align: "center", size: 15, color: color || COL.gold2, wrap: w, bold: true }).h;
// Pop-up "+100" labels
CN.drawPops = function (ctx) {
ctx.pops = ctx.pops.filter(p => UI.t - p.t < 1.4);

ctx.pops.forEach((p, i) => { const a = UI.t - p.t; UI.text("pop" + i, p.text, p.x, p.y - a * 60, { anchor: "center", valign: "middle", size: 30, font: "title", color: p.color, alpha: 1 - a / 1.4, top: true }); });
// QUIZ — active team answers; a miss can be stolen for half points
CH.quiz = {
init(ctx) {
ctx.qs = CN.drawQuestions(ctx.station.pool, 3);
ctx.i = 0; ctx.phase = "answer"; ctx.setTimer(30); ctx.max = 3 * 160; ctx.helpable = true; ctx.removed = new Set(); ctx.wrong = new Set();
ctx.canHelp = () => ctx.phase === "answer";
ctx.onHelp = () => { const q = ctx.qs[ctx.i]; CN.shuffle(q.opts.map((o, i) => i).filter(i => !q.opts[i].ok)).slice(0, 2).forEach(i => ctx.removed.add(i)); };
frame(ctx, A) {
const q = ctx.qs[ctx.i], others = CN.state.teams.map((t, i) => i).filter(i => i !== ctx.team);
let y = A.y;
UI.text("qz:n", `Question ${ctx.i + 1} of 3`, A.x, y, { size: 13, bold: true, color: COL.muted });
if (ctx.phase !== "reveal" && ctx.phase !== "steal-pick") {
const left = drawTimer(ctx, A.x + 120, y + 5, A.w - 120);
if (left <= 0) this.miss(ctx);
y += questionCard("qz:q", q.q, A.x, y, A.w) + 12;
const phaseText =
ctx.phase === "answer" ? `${teamName(ctx.team)}, talk it over and choose!`
: ctx.phase === "steal-pick" ? (others.length ? "Missed! Other teams: tap your name to steal it for half points." : "Missed!")
: ctx.phase === "steal-answer" ? `${teamName(ctx.stealer)} steals — choose wisely!`
: (ctx.lastOk ? "Correct! " : "The right answer is highlighted. ") + q.x;
y += note("qz:p", phaseText, A.x, y, A.w, ctx.phase === "reveal" ? (ctx.lastOk ? COL.ok : COL.warm) : COL.gold2) + 12;
const bottomH = (ctx.phase === "steal-pick" || ctx.phase === "reveal") ? 64 : 0;
const lay = optionsLayout({ x: A.x, y, w: A.w, h: A.y + A.h - y - bottomH }, q.opts.length);
q.opts.forEach((o, i) => {
const r = lay(i);
let state = "normal";
if (ctx.removed.has(i)) state = "off";
if (ctx.phase === "steal-answer" && ctx.wrong.has(i)) state = "wrong";
if (ctx.phase === "steal-pick") state = ctx.wrong.has(i) ? "wrong" : "dim";
if (ctx.phase === "reveal") state = o.ok ? "right" : ctx.wrong.has(i) ? "wrong" : "dim";
if (answerBtn("qz:o" + i, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, o.t, state) && state === "normal") this.answer(ctx, i, r);
const by = A.y + A.h - 52;
if (ctx.phase === "steal-pick") {
const n = others.length + 1, gap = 8, w = (A.w - gap * (n - 1)) / n;

others.forEach((ti, k) => { if (UI.button("qz:s" + ti, A.x + k * (w + gap), by, w, 50, teamName(ti), { color: teamCol(ti), size: 15 })) { ctx.stealer = ti; ctx.phase = "steal-answer"; ctx.setTimer(15); CN.sfx("buzz"); } });
if (UI.button("qz:ns", A.x + others.length * (w + gap), by, w, 50, "No steal", { kind: "ghost", size: 15 })) this.reveal(ctx, false);
if (ctx.phase === "reveal" && UI.button("qz:next", A.x + A.w / 2 - 130, by, 260, 50, ctx.i < 2 ? "Next question" : "See results")) {
if (ctx.i < 2) { ctx.i++; ctx.phase = "answer"; ctx.removed = new Set(); ctx.wrong = new Set(); ctx.setTimer(30); } else ctx.finish();
answer(ctx, i, r) {
const q = ctx.qs[ctx.i], ok = q.opts[i].ok;
if (ctx.phase === "answer") {
if (ok) { CN.sfx("correct"); ctx.give(ctx.team, 100 + Math.round(Math.min(60, ctx.left() * 2)), { x: r.x + r.w / 2, y: r.y }); this.reveal(ctx, true); }
else { ctx.wrong.add(i); this.miss(ctx); }
} else if (ctx.phase === "steal-answer") {
if (ok) { CN.sfx("correct"); ctx.give(ctx.stealer, 50, { stat: "steal", x: r.x + r.w / 2, y: r.y }); this.reveal(ctx, true); }
else { ctx.wrong.add(i); this.reveal(ctx, false); }
miss(ctx) {
CN.sfx("wrong");
if (ctx.phase === "answer" && CN.state.teams.length > 1) { ctx.phase = "steal-pick"; }
else this.reveal(ctx, false);
reveal(ctx, ok) { ctx.phase = "reveal"; ctx.lastOk = ok; if (!ok) CN.sfx("wrong", 40); },
// BUZZER — every team; first to buzz answers. Also the Grand Finale.
CH.buzzer = {
init(ctx) {
const fin = ctx.type === "finale";
ctx.qs = fin ? [].concat(CN.drawQuestions("culinary", 2), CN.drawQuestions("artistic", 2), CN.drawQuestions("cultural", 1), CN.drawQuestions("festival", 1)) : CN.drawQuestions(ctx.station.pool, 5);
if (fin) ctx.qs = CN.shuffle(ctx.qs);
ctx.value = fin ? C.finale.points : 100;
ctx.i = 0; this.reset(ctx);
ctx.max = ctx.value * ctx.qs.length;
reset(ctx) { ctx.phase = "buzz"; ctx.locked = new Set(); ctx.buzzer = null; ctx.winner = null; ctx.wrong = new Set(); ctx.setTimer(20); },
frame(ctx, A) {
const q = ctx.qs[ctx.i], teams = CN.state.teams, n = teams.length;
// buzzers area
const cols = UI.portrait ? Math.min(n, n <= 4 ? 2 : 3) : n;
const rows = Math.ceil(n / cols), bh = UI.compact ? 50 : 62, gap = 8;
const bzH = rows * bh + (rows - 1) * gap;
let y = A.y;
UI.text("bz:n", `Question ${ctx.i + 1} of ${ctx.qs.length} · ${ctx.value} pts`, A.x, y, { size: 13, bold: true, color: COL.muted });
if (ctx.phase !== "reveal") { if (drawTimer(ctx, A.x + 190, y + 5, A.w - 190) <= 0) this.timeout(ctx); }
y += questionCard("bz:q", q.q, A.x, y, A.w) + 10;
const msg = ctx.phase === "buzz" ? (ctx.locked.size ? "Wrong! The others can still buzz in…" : "Know it? Hit your team’s buzzer first!")
: ctx.phase === "answer" ? `${teamName(ctx.buzzer)} buzzed! Choose your answer.`
: (ctx.winner != null ? `${teamName(ctx.winner)} scores! ` : "Nobody got it. ") + q.x;
y += note("bz:m", msg, A.x, y, A.w, ctx.phase === "answer" ? teamCol(ctx.buzzer) : COL.gold2) + 10;
const optsH = A.y + A.h - bzH - 14 - y;
const lay = optionsLayout({ x: A.x, y, w: A.w, h: optsH }, q.opts.length);
q.opts.forEach((o, i) => {
const r = lay(i);
let state = ctx.phase === "answer" ? (ctx.wrong.has(i) ? "wrong" : "normal") : "dim";
if (ctx.phase === "reveal") state = o.ok ? "right" : ctx.wrong.has(i) ? "wrong" : "dim";
if (answerBtn("bz:o" + i, r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, o.t, state)) this.answer(ctx, i, r);
const by = A.y + A.h - bzH, bw = (A.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
if (ctx.phase === "reveal") {
if (UI.button("bz:next", A.x + A.w / 2 - 130, A.y + A.h - 52, 260, 50, ctx.i < ctx.qs.length - 1 ? "Next question" : "See results")) {
if (ctx.i < ctx.qs.length - 1) { ctx.i++; this.reset(ctx); } else ctx.finish();
return;
teams.forEach((t, ti) => {
const x = A.x + (ti % cols) * (bw + gap), yy = by + Math.floor(ti / cols) * (bh + gap);
const locked = ctx.locked.has(ti) || (ctx.phase === "answer");
const active = ctx.phase === "answer" && ctx.buzzer === ti;

const hit = UI.button("bz:b" + ti, x, yy, bw, bh, t.name, { color: t.color, disabled: locked && !active, sub: active ? "answering…" : ctx.locked.has(ti) ? "locked" : n <= 6 && !UI.compact ? "key " + (ti + 1) : null, size: 15, silent: true });
if (ctx.phase === "buzz" && !ctx.locked.has(ti) && (hit || UI.key(49 + ti))) { ctx.buzzer = ti; ctx.phase = "answer"; ctx.setTimer(12); CN.sfx("buzz"); }
answer(ctx, i, r) {
const q = ctx.qs[ctx.i];

if (q.opts[i].ok) { CN.sfx("correct"); ctx.winner = ctx.buzzer; ctx.give(ctx.buzzer, ctx.value, { stat: "buzz", trail: ctx.type === "finale" ? null : undefined, x: r.x + r.w / 2, y: r.y }); ctx.phase = "reveal"; }

else { CN.sfx("wrong"); ctx.wrong.add(i); ctx.locked.add(ctx.buzzer); ctx.buzzer = null; if (ctx.locked.size >= CN.state.teams.length) { ctx.winner = null; ctx.phase = "reveal"; } else { ctx.phase = "buzz"; ctx.setTimer(Math.max(8, ctx.left())); } }
timeout(ctx) {

if (ctx.phase === "answer") { CN.sfx("wrong"); ctx.locked.add(ctx.buzzer); ctx.buzzer = null; if (ctx.locked.size >= CN.state.teams.length) { ctx.winner = null; ctx.phase = "reveal"; } else { ctx.phase = "buzz"; ctx.setTimer(8); } }
else { ctx.winner = null; ctx.phase = "reveal"; CN.sfx("wrong", 40); }
// MAP — "Where in Nancy?": every team pins two landmarks
const mapMax = h => 300 - 60 * (h - 1);
CH.map = {
init(ctx) {
ctx.places = CN.shuffle(ctx.station.set).slice(0, 2);
ctx.li = 0; ctx.max = 600; ctx.helpable = true;
const n = CN.state.teams.length;
ctx.order = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => (ctx.team + k) % n);
this.startLandmark(ctx);
ctx.canHelp = () => ctx.phase === "pin" && ctx.order[ctx.k] === ctx.team;
ctx.onHelp = () => { ctx.hints = 3; ctx.free = true; };
startLandmark(ctx) { ctx.k = 0; ctx.pins = []; ctx.phase = "pin"; ctx.hints = 1; ctx.free = false; ctx.pin = null; },
frame(ctx, A) {
const place = C.places[ctx.places[ctx.li]], ti = ctx.order[ctx.k];
// layout: side panel + map
const land = !UI.portrait;
const pw = land ? CN.clamp(A.w * .38, 260, 380) : A.w;
const ph = land ? A.h : CN.clamp(A.h * .36, 150, 260);
const P = { x: land ? A.x + A.w - pw : A.x, y: A.y, w: pw, h: ph };
const R = land ? { x: A.x, y: A.y, w: A.w - pw - 14, h: A.h } : { x: A.x, y: A.y + ph + 10, w: A.w, h: A.h - ph - 10 };
const k = Math.min(R.w / C.map.width, R.h / C.map.height);
const M = { w: C.map.width * k, h: C.map.height * k }; M.x = R.x + (R.w - M.w) / 2; M.y = R.y + (R.h - M.h) / 2;
UI.rect(M.x - 4, M.y - 4, M.w + 8, M.h + 8, { fill: COL.gold, r: 8 });
UI.sprite("NancyMap", "map", null, M.x, M.y, M.w, M.h);
const toXY = p => { const f = CN.geoToMap(p); return [M.x + f[0] * M.w, M.y + f[1] * M.h]; };
// panel
UI.panel(P.x, P.y, P.w, P.h);
let y = P.y + 14; const px = P.x + 16, pw2 = P.w - 32;
UI.text("mp:l", `Landmark ${ctx.li + 1} of ${ctx.places.length}`, px, y, { size: 12, bold: true, color: COL.muted }); y += 20;
if (ctx.phase === "pin") {
CN.teamPill("mp:t", ti, px, y, 30, { size: 14 }); y += 40;
const shown = UI.portrait ? [place.hints[ctx.hints - 1]] : place.hints.slice(0, ctx.hints);
shown.forEach((h, i) => { const m = UI.text("mp:h" + i, (UI.portrait ? `Clue ${ctx.hints}: ` : "• ") + h, px, y, { size: UI.compact ? 13 : 15, wrap: pw2 }); y += m.h + 6; });
const by = P.y + P.h - 50;
const half = (pw2 - 8) / 2;

if (UI.button("mp:more", px, by, half, 40, ctx.hints < 3 ? `More clues (max ${mapMax(ctx.free ? 1 : ctx.hints + 1)})` : "All clues shown", { kind: "ghost", size: 13, disabled: ctx.hints >= 3 })) ctx.hints++;
if (UI.button("mp:lock", px + half + 8, by, half, 40, ctx.pin ? "Lock in pin" : "Tap the map", { size: 14, disabled: !ctx.pin, color: teamCol(ti) })) {
const g = CN.mapToGeo(ctx.pin[0], ctx.pin[1]), d = CN.dist(g, place.p), max = ctx.free ? 300 : mapMax(ctx.hints);
ctx.pins.push({ ti, f: ctx.pin, d, pts: d < 30 ? max : Math.round(max * Math.exp(-d / 380)) });
ctx.pin = null; ctx.hints = 1; ctx.free = false; ctx.k++;
CN.sfx("click");
if (ctx.k >= ctx.order.length) this.reveal(ctx);
else CN.toast(`Pass the device to ${teamName(ctx.order[ctx.k])}`, teamCol(ctx.order[ctx.k]));
const tap = UI.tapPoint(M.x, M.y, M.w, M.h);
if (tap) { ctx.pin = [(tap[0] - M.x) / M.w, (tap[1] - M.y) / M.h]; CN.sfx("tick", 50); }

if (ctx.pin) { const x = M.x + ctx.pin[0] * M.w, yy = M.y + ctx.pin[1] * M.h; UI.circle(x, yy, 11, { fill: teamCol(ti), stroke: COL.night, sw: 3, layer: "mid" }); UI.circle(x, yy, 3, { fill: COL.night, layer: "mid" }); }
} else {
UI.text("mp:pn", place.name, px, y, { size: 20, font: "title", color: COL.gold2, wrap: pw2 }); y += 30;
const sorted = ctx.pins.slice().sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
sorted.forEach((p, i) => {
UI.circle(px + 8, y + 9, 7, { fill: teamCol(p.ti) });
UI.fitText("mp:r" + i, teamName(p.ti), px + 22, y, pw2 - 130, { size: 14, bold: true });
UI.text("mp:rd" + i, CN.fmtDist(p.d) + "  +" + p.pts, px + pw2, y, { anchor: "right", size: 14, color: i === 0 ? COL.ok : COL.muted });
if (!UI.portrait) UI.text("mp:f", place.fact, px, y + 6, { size: 13, color: COL.muted, wrap: pw2 });
const last = ctx.li >= ctx.places.length - 1;
if (UI.button("mp:next", px, P.y + P.h - 50, pw2, 40, last ? "See results" : "Next landmark", { size: 15 })) {
if (last) ctx.finish(); else { ctx.li++; this.startLandmark(ctx); CN.toast(`${teamName(ctx.order[0])} pins first`, teamCol(ctx.order[0])); }
const [tx, ty] = toXY(place.p);

ctx.pins.forEach(p => { const x = M.x + p.f[0] * M.w, yy = M.y + p.f[1] * M.h; UI.line(x, yy, tx, ty, { color: COL.ink, w: 2, alpha: .7, layer: "mid", dash: 5 }); UI.circle(x, yy, 9, { fill: teamCol(p.ti), stroke: COL.night, sw: 2.5, layer: "mid" }); });
UI.circle(tx, ty, 15, { fill: COL.night, layer: "mid" }); UI.star(tx, ty, 11, { fill: COL.gold, layer: "mid" });
reveal(ctx) {
ctx.phase = "reveal";
ctx.pins.forEach(p => ctx.give(p.ti, p.pts, { stat: "map", statValue: p.pts }));
CN.sfx("correct");
// RECIPE RELAY — pick only the authentic ingredients
CH.recipe = {

init(ctx) { ctx.di = 0; ctx.max = 500; ctx.helpable = true; this.startDish(ctx); ctx.canHelp = () => ctx.phase === "pick"; ctx.onHelp = () => { ctx.chips.map((c, i) => i).filter(i => !ctx.chips[i].good && !ctx.sel.has(i)).slice(0, 2).forEach(i => ctx.struck.add(i)); }; },

startDish(ctx) { const d = C.recipes[ctx.di]; ctx.chips = CN.shuffle([...d.good.map(t => ({ t, good: true })), ...d.bad.map(t => ({ t, good: false }))]); ctx.sel = new Set(); ctx.struck = new Set(); ctx.phase = "pick"; ctx.setTimer(50); },
frame(ctx, A) {
const d = C.recipes[ctx.di];
let y = A.y;
UI.text("rc:n", `Dish ${ctx.di + 1} of ${C.recipes.length}`, A.x, y, { size: 13, bold: true, color: COL.muted });
if (ctx.phase === "pick" && drawTimer(ctx, A.x + 110, y + 5, A.w - 110) <= 0) this.serve(ctx);
const cs = UI.compact ? 48 : 64;
UI.curio("rc:c", "quichou", A.x + cs / 2, y + cs / 2, cs);
UI.text("rc:d", d.dish, A.x + cs + 12, y + 4, { size: UI.compact ? 22 : 28, font: "title", color: COL.gold2 });

UI.text("rc:i", ctx.phase === "pick" ? `Choose the 5 authentic ingredients · ${ctx.sel.size}/5 selected` : d.x, A.x + cs + 12, y + (UI.compact ? 30 : 40), { size: 14, color: ctx.phase === "pick" ? COL.muted : COL.warm, wrap: A.w - cs - 12 });
const cols = A.w > 760 ? 5 : A.w > 520 ? 3 : 2, gap = 10, n = ctx.chips.length, rows = Math.ceil(n / cols);
const ch = CN.clamp((A.y + A.h - 70 - y - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows, 40, 84), cw = (A.w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
ctx.chips.forEach((c, i) => {
const x = A.x + (i % cols) * (cw + gap), yy = y + Math.floor(i / cols) * (ch + gap);
const sel = ctx.sel.has(i), struck = ctx.struck.has(i);
let fill = sel ? CN.mix(COL.gold, COL.night, .35) : COL.night3, stroke = sel ? COL.gold : COL.line, alpha = struck ? .3 : 1;
